description: This file defines an interface `TaggedMetricInstrument` that extends `MetricInstrument`, providing methods for adding, retrieving, and managing tags (key-value pairs) associated with metrics, including support for types long, double, boolean, and String. It includes default methods to facilitate tagging with primitive types by converting them to strings.

methods.name: tag(String, long)
methods.description: Adds a tag with a long value, converting it to a string. Overrides any existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: tag(String, double)
methods.description: Adds a tag with a double value, converting it to a string. Overrides existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: tag(String, boolean)
methods.description: Adds a tag with a boolean value, converting it to a string. Overrides existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: tag(String, String)
methods.description: Adds a tag with a string value. Overrides existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: tags(Map<String, String>)
methods.description: Adds multiple tags from the provided map, overriding existing tags with the same keys.

methods.name: getTag(String)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the tag associated with the specified key, may return null.

methods.name: getTags()
methods.description: Returns a map containing all tags.
